5.
What is the total profit at the level of proposed sales mix (with Product W)?
(A)  ` 10,95,000
(B)  ` 21,15,000
(C)  ` 15,62,500
(D)  ` 19,60,000
(2 Marks)
Case Scenario - II
Spice Guard Ltd. manufactures 'Pepper Spray' that is used by women for their
self-defence. As per the estimates, there will be an average quarterly total market
demand of 3,125 units of 'Pepper Spray'. Spice Guard Ltd. is expected to have 8%
market share of the total market demand of the 'Pepper Spray'.
